continuity: Sama Pyo risks his life rather than dodge an enemy attack into an ally; a young Black Dragon Demon Gate martial artist he had saved dies intercepting the attack for him.
Sama Pyo confronts Sima Gong over his delayed arrival and suspected other intentions, and says the Black Dragon Demon Gate will survive regardless of the battle’s outcome.
Sima Gong’s earlier order placed two men who spoke of the Black Dragon Demon Gate’s and Sama Pyo’s hidden history in the front line; both died there.
Sima Gong arrives at the front with the Black Dragon Demon Gate’s elite martial artists.
Jin Taekyung launches White Flame at the Blood-Sword Demon Lord, who was charging the already wounded Jeok Cheongang; the outcome is unresolved.
plot: Sama Pyo realizes he can dodge a powerful enemy’s Sword Energy only by exposing an ally to it, so he stays and is nearly killed. A young Black Dragon Demon Gate martial artist he had saved earlier intervenes and dies saving him. Sima Gong arrives with the Gate’s elite, and Sama Pyo confronts him for delaying his arrival and choosing a different path from his father’s. Sima Gong recognizes the dead young man as one of two people he had ordered placed in the front line, where both died. Elsewhere, Jin Taekyung cuts through the enemy ranks with controlled weapons and launches White Flame at the Blood-Sword Demon Lord as he charges Jeok Cheongang; the result is unresolved.
translation_decisions: Keep 흑귀 as Black Ghost and 흑룡도 as Black Dragon Saber.
Keep 백염 as White Flame, 강기 as Force, and 의지 as Will.

active_continuity: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord serves the Lord of Heaven and commands the invading army.
Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung are fighting on the battlefield; Jeok is wounded and facing the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
Sama Pyo stayed in the front line rather than dodge an attack into an ally; a young Black Dragon Demon Gate martial artist died saving him.
Sima Gong arrived at the front with the Black Dragon Demon Gate’s elite after delaying his intervention; he had ordered two men placed in the front line, and both died.
Sama Pyo openly challenged Sima Gong and chose a path different from his father’s; he says the Black Dragon Demon Gate will survive regardless of the battle’s outcome.
Jin Taekyung controls many weapons with his Will, but they are depleted or deflected as he advances through the enemy ranks.
Jin Taekyung launched White Flame at the Blood-Sword Demon Lord; the result is unresolved.
open_questions: What are the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven?
Did Dark Heaven cause the Great Faction War?
Who is the unnamed white-robed woman, and what is the white-robed followers’ purpose?
How do the white-robed followers’ Magic and the Wind Ghost’s power work?
How were the former Demonic Cult fiends made into Black Ghosts?

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Outwardly courteous and calculating, he is protective of Taishan and pragmatic in combat; he recognizes that his father's ruthless, survival-driven worldview shaped him, even as its influence weighs on him.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Outwardly courteous and calculating, he protects those beside him even at personal risk and has begun rejecting his father's survival-at-any-cost worldview.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Sama Pyo commands the absolutely loyal Taishan and is Sima Gong's son and heir; his father's ruthless treatment of family shaped his rise and remains a source of inner constraint. He joined the Fire Dragon Pavilion intending to use Jin Taekyung, and Sima Gong has now ordered him to spy on Taekyung's group. Taekyung rejects defining him by his unorthodox affiliation, and Sama Pyo admires Taekyung. He was Ju Hwaran's former fiancé in a political engagement and is openly hostile toward fellow member Song Ilseom.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Sama Pyo commands the absolutely loyal Taishan and is Sima Gong's son and heir, but now openly challenges his father and chooses a different path. He joined the Fire Dragon Pavilion intending to use Jin Taekyung, who rejects defining him by his unorthodox affiliation and whom Sama Pyo admires; Sima Gong ordered him to spy on Taekyung's group. He was Ju Hwaran's former fiancé in a political engagement and is openly hostile toward fellow member Song Ilseom.
